paragraphs: Chananyah of Ono testified: Sanhedrin 11b. Gittin, HaOmer, mishnah 7, 66b, has Chanina. He brought up a law from prison—in the name of R. Akiva, who was imprisoned, according to Rashi. He appears in a dispute involving R. Meir and R. Yosi and is one of the five who argued before the sages; see there.
